public.summary: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining, extending UNIFIL's mandate until 31 August 2024, reaffirming its independence without prior permission and continued coordination with the Government under the status-of-forces agreement.

Brazil.summary: Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work, judging the French text kept the mandate robust and addressed some of Lebanon's concerns.
Brazil.mission_support_quote: kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely

China.summary: China supported UNIFIL's work but noted the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns.

host_concerns.quote: the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns

Russia.summary: Russia attributed its abstention to late drafting changes and supported the mission's activities.
Russia.mission_support_quote: It continued to support the mission's activities
